x-semantic-rules.predicate: size(set(tuple(run.run_ref.schema_id, run.run_ref.schema_version, run.run_ref.artifact_type, run.run_ref.artifact_id, run.run_ref.content_hash) for run in runs)) == size(runs)

classification == FULL_CATALOG iff size(runs) >= 2 AND at least two distinct canonical run_ref identity tuples exist AND every run has exactly ordered checkpoints CATALOG_LOAD, AFTER_NATURAL_UPDATE, RUN_CLOSE AND at every checkpoint decimal(reconciled_fixture_numerator) == decimal(visible_fixture_denominator) AND every checkpoint unexplained_gap_count == 0 AND report unexplained_gap_count == 0
classification == PARTIAL_CATALOG iff size(runs) >= 1 AND usable checkpoint evidence exists AND FULL_CATALOG predicate is false
classification == UNSUPPORTED iff size(runs) == 0 AND run_count == 0 AND usable checkpoint evidence is absent

FULL_CATALOG maps to report_summary.disposition SUPPORTED with empty limitation_codes and unknown_codes; PARTIAL_CATALOG maps to PARTIAL with nonempty limitation_codes; UNSUPPORTED maps to UNSUPPORTED with nonempty evidence_refs and limitation_codes

FULL_CATALOG iff observed_global_state_class_count == required_global_state_class_count AND unknown_global_state_class_count == 0 AND referenced catalog classification is FULL_CATALOG; PARTIAL_CATALOG iff observed_global_state_class_count > 0 AND FULL_CATALOG predicate is false; UNSUPPORTED iff observed_global_state_class_count == 0

price_transformation_disposition and tick_inference_disposition are THRESHOLD_MET iff matched_revision_count >= 30 AND distinct_fixture_count >= 3 AND distinct_run_count >= 2; otherwise each is INFERRED_WITH_LIMITS or UNKNOWN
natural_operator_traffic == true AND one_detail_tab_per_fixture_used == false AND traffic_source == NATURAL_OPERATOR_TRAFFIC AND generated_load == false wherever those fields apply
p99.availability == AVAILABLE iff decimal(sample_count) >= 1000; otherwise p99.availability == UNKNOWN and reason_code == SAMPLE_COUNT_BELOW_1000
